svg.text: Proof build, basic current only. Row 1 at the top. J1 pad order read from the real board.
Blue block: J1, USB-C socket board (from the charger)
Green block: Q1 on its adapter board
Purple rings: the three wires of the cut cable (to the phone)
Red wire: 5 V. Black wire: ground. Blue wire: signal
Dashed parts (R4, R5): left out on the breadboard
